Dear Team,
As part of our ongoing commitment to information security and protecting both company and client data, we would like to remind all employees of the following essential practices regarding account access and login credentials:

Never share your email, username, or password with anyone, under any circumstances. Your login credentials are strictly private and must remain confidential.
Always log out from unfamiliar or shared devices, and never save your login details in web browsers. This prevents unauthorized access to your accounts.
Log out of your company/personal devices during breaks and after working hours. Leaving accounts active on unattended devices poses a serious security risk.
Change your CRM and email passwords at least once a month. Regular password updates significantly reduce the risk of compromised accounts.

These measures are critical to safeguarding our systems, your personal information, and the sensitive data we handle daily. Your cooperation is both expected and greatly appreciated.
Should you have any questions or require assistance, please do not hesitate to contact the IT or HR Department.
Thank you for your continued vigilance and commitment to keeping our workplace secure.
